Title: City owned trees [Illinois--Champaign-Urbana] {2025}
Description: Historical dataset of City owned trees in Champaign-Urbana, Illinois as of 2025. This layer is maintained by the public works department. It is an inventory of tree sites originally performed by the Davey Tree Company in 2011. Updates have been applied by the GIS Technician in the Public Works Department. Additions and changes are determined by Forestry Staff based on GPS data collection, maps, site visits, and staff knowledge.
